what: Addendum to prediction_safety_guard_nim.json: the study's arm J6 run again on the day of the NIM arms
why: the events of the NIM arms record graphics driver 610.88; every earlier run of this volume, the study's J6 of 2026-10-02 included, records 591.86. J6N against the study's J6 therefore differs in two things, the serving package and the driver (and the day). The pre-registration named one.
found_when: after the NIM arms had run (2026-10-06 04:04 to 04:31), while reading their events; their figures were known by then: J6N gave 38.5 verdicts per second at c=16 on prompts and 24.5 on responses, the study's J6 45.9 and 30.1

arm.name: J6-today
arm.served_by: upstream vLLM, the pinned image and model snapshot of the study (p93_common.VLLM, HF_SG8), the container command of the study
arm.cells: per track: precheck, c=1 on the 200-item subset, c=16 on the whole track; no stability rerun

one_variable_against.J6N: the serving package (same day, same driver, same host)

what_each_outcome_means.J6-today is like the study's J6 (within: the driver and the day did not move this arm; the 16% to 19% between J6 and J6N belong to the serving package
what_each_outcome_means.J6-today is like J6N: the difference belongs to the day or the driver, and nothing is said about the package
what_each_outcome_means.in between: both figures are reported and the difference is not assigned

expectation: like the study's J6, within 5%: the Vol.4 cells of the same night, on another kind of model, repeated their 2026-10-04 values within 2.5% across the same driver change. Confidence moderate.
not_bound_by_the_frozen_file: this program was written after the freeze; the frozen programs it calls are unchanged

first_attempt.what: the program as first written did not parse (a line break inside a string); Python stopped before the program did anything: no container was started and no event was written
first_attempt.then: the string was repaired, this file was rewritten with the new SHA-256 and time, and nothing else in it was changed
